The MAS-36 rifle had a hidden bayonet stored inside the barrel — a unique French design meant to make storage easier. But there was a catch: soldiers occasionally fused two rifles together by mistake! Learn the full story of this bolt-action rifle's ingenious (and flawed) bayonet system from World War II military history at Simple History.
